question: Does the radical product of two fixed rational Kummer classes explicitly realize their central governing cochain, with a Frobenius bit readable from an octic?
layer: solubility obstruction; retrospective rational controls only

cases.role: first two generic directions; observed-zero-gain control

model: Use each frozen integral cubic and its specified rational Weierstrass scaling; do not identify cochain gauges across different scalings.
symbolic_endpoint: Verify the quartic radical-product identity in a rank-eight free algebra; verify the corrected cup cocycle on all 96 squared pairs; verify a faithful degree-eight action of all 192 elements and both inert Frobenius cycle types.
arithmetic_endpoint: Replay existing pair independence; write exact rational and integral octics and their nonzero discriminants; factor reductions at every eligible odd prime at most 199; independently evaluate the radical product in the cubic finite field.
exclusions: No new points, original parameters, twists, candidate scores, global class groups, or searches for favorable primes. No rational-solubility inference from zero CT. Inert-prime tables alone do not satisfy the twist theorem's local-square hypotheses.
